Webcam controls on Windows, a working Presets menu, and a darker title bar.

## New

- On Windows, the Webcam card shows the camera's own controls too, like brightness, exposure, focus, zoom and pan. Before, only Linux had them.

## Fixed

- Loading, renaming and deleting a preset from the Presets menu works again. Clicking one did nothing before.
- Dragging a slider on the Webcam card no longer gets cut off halfway.
- If an antivirus blocks the camera, Telescope says access was blocked instead of saying another app is using it, and it can try again once you allow it without restarting the computer.
- On Windows, the webcam list leaves out the uncompressed sizes that can't keep up and only lag.
- On Windows, the title bar is dark to match the app and shows Telescope's icon.

## Changed

- "Device" now means anything that can stream to Telescope: a phone, a browser or a webcam. The picker says "Pick a device", and "Your phones" is now "Your devices".
